_meta.title: Job — key verses (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Curated key verses from Job (worship in loss, 'I know my redeemer lives,' refined as gold, God's answer from the whirlwind, seeing God). Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 18 Job); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: key verses from the poetic dialogue; the long speech-cycles are represented by their high points
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.
_meta.note: getbible's KJV renders the divine name as 'the Lord'; text is verbatim KJV. No review gate — author is reviewer.

verses.text: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord.
verses.plain: He said: 'Naked I came from my mother's womb, and naked I will depart. The Lord gave and the Lord has taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord.'

verses.text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.plain: I know that my redeemer lives, and that in the end he will stand upon the earth.

verses.text: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.plain: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tested me, I will come out as gold.

verses.text: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.plain: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell me, if you understand.

verses.text: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
verses.plain: I know that you can do all things; no purpose of yours can be thwarted.

verses.text: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
verses.plain: My ears had heard of you, but now my eyes have seen you.
